Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Kumar, Judge

 Order

From a reading of Order dated 03.07.2024, it transpires that the competent authority has already issued a notification under Section 7(1) of the Requisitioning and Acquisition of Immovable Property Act, 1952 for acquisition of the requisitioned land.

entities.text: Requisitioning and Acquisition of Immovable Property Act, 1952
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, the competent authority is not proceeding further in the matter in view of pending clarification from the Government.

2. A communication from the office of Divisional Commissioner with the Secretary to the Govt.,
Revenue Department dated 23.08.2024 is brought to our notice.

From a perusal whereof, it transpires that the clarification has been sought by the competent authority in reference to Rule 34 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rules, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Social Impact Assessment and Consent) Rules, 2023 framed by the Government by Rakesh Khajuria And Ors vs Sachin Kumar Vaishya on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21101968/
1 SO No. 440 dated 24.08.2023.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rules, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Social Impact Assessment and Consent) Rules, 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Rakesh Khajuria And Ors vs Sachin Kumar Vaishya
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A plain reading of Rule 34 shows that the limit of amount, as mentioned in the Rule, is only for the purposes of approval of the award.

3. We, therefore, provide that pending clarification by the Government or till the matter is determined by this Court, the competent authority shall proceed with the acquisition proceedings but shall not publish the final award.

4. List on 04.10.2024.
 (Rajesh Sekhri) (Sanjeev Kumar)
